answer_1.quote: Graph-to-sequence (Graph2Seq) learning has attracted lots of attention in recent years. Many Natural Language Process (NLP) problems involve learning from not only sequential data but also more complex structured data, such as semantic graphs. For example, AMR-to-text generation is a task of generating text from Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR) graphs...
